text:
Situation: Verapamil hydrochloride 120 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 209 tablets (21.9 days at 9.5/day). Corvale General holds 442 tablets (31.4 days at 14.1/day). The current supply label names Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028) with operations RELABEL and REPACK.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Proficient Rx LP show a VAI classification on 2015-10-22 and another VAI on 2022-12-08. FDA's drug shortage list does not include verapamil hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at East and one month at General. No national shortage is declared. The registered plant for current stock has two historical VAI inspections. Multiple alternative suppliers are available and not on FDA's shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc. as primary replenishment source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if not currently listed.
2. Buyer to qualify AvKARE, Cadila Pharmaceuticals Limited, Chartwell RX LLC, and Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA as secondary sources; requires P&T committee approval for each new supplier.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and adjust reorder points weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.
4. Buyer to request updated inspection history for Proficient Rx LP from FDA; requires regulatory affairs approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
